Priya (CSM): Helio Labs reporting high 429s during staging SDK init. They see a stampede of preflight auth calls right after deploy. Can someone triage?
Helio-Dev (customer): yep — here are the logs:  
```
POST /v1/session 429 {"error":"rate_limited", "retry_after":1}
POST /v1/session 429 {"error":"rate_limited", "retry_after":1}
```
We spin up ~200 short-lived worker processes which all call SDK.init() at boot.
Luca (SDK): sounds like a classic ephemeral-token fanout. SDK versions <0.9.x didn't coalesce preflight requests by default. What SDK version are you on? @Helio-Dev
Helio-Dev (customer): using 0.8.7 in staging.
Aisha (Support): ok that matches. Two quick mitigations: 1) upgrade to 0.9.3 which has preflight coalescing and jittering turned on by default, OR 2) set env vars to enable coalescing in 0.8.x for a quick test.
Luca (SDK): config snippet (works in node env):
```bash
export REDWOOD_SDK_PREFLIGHT_COALESCE=true
export REDWOOD_SDK_PREFLIGHT_SPLAY_MS=250
export REDWOOD_SDK_PREFLIGHT_MAX_COALESCE=8
```
And client-side backoff example (pseudo):
```js
async function authWithBackoff() {
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++){
    try { return await sdk.init(); } catch(e){ await sleep(2**i * 50 + jitter()); }
  }
  throw new Error('init failed');
}
```
Sam (SRE): also check token TTL. If tokens expire in ~10s and you restart 200 workers, you'll re-request auth many times. Can you tell TTL?
Helio-Dev (customer): TTL is 12s right now (we set low intentionally for security during dev).
Aisha (Support): that explains it — short TTL + simultaneous init = stampede. Short-term test: increase TTL to 60s in staging or gate worker start so only a few prefetch. Long-term: use token lease + coalescing.
Priya (CSM): Action items: 1) Helio increase TTL to 60s for staging and enable the env vars Luca suggested, 2) Helio run another deploy and paste the logs here, 3) SDK team to prepare a small patch we can enable via feature-flag for older versions if upgrade isn't possible.
onboard-bot: feature-flag "prefetch-coalesce-compat" enabled for helio-staging by Priya (CSM) :white_check_mark:
Helio-Dev (customer): toggled TTL->60s and enabled the env vars. Re-ran deploy, logs: 
```
POST /v1/session 200 {"token":"..."}
POST /v1/session 200 {"token":"..."}
429s dropped from ~190 -> 7 over the first minute
```
Helio-Dev (customer): looks much better. will run load test later today and report.
Luca (SDK): great. we'll draft a small upgrade note for Helio on the 0.9.3 release and a fallback flag for older SDKs.
Aisha (Support): I'll follow up with a short runbook for customers hitting this pattern (include TTL guidance, coalescing env vars, and sample backoff).
Priya (CSM): thanks everyone — logging this as "needs follow-up" for renewal health (customer saw reduced errors). Will check back after load test. :thumbsup:
